question: How many floating holidays do employees get each year?
gold_answer: 2 floating holidays per calendar year (prorated for new hires starting on/after July 1).
answer: Each eligible employee is entitled to two floating holidays per calendar year [2][3]. New hires who start before July 1 receive the full two holidays for that year [1][4]. New hires who start on or after July 1 receive one floating holiday for that year [1][4]. Unused floating holidays expire on December 31 and do not carry over [2][4]. Floating holidays are not paid out at separation [2].

question: Can I paste customer data into a public AI chatbot?
gold_answer: No. Confidential or Restricted data (including customer data) must never be entered into unapproved or public AI tools.
answer: No. Customer data is classified as Restricted and must never be entered into unapproved or public AI tools. The IT Acceptable Use Policy explicitly states you cannot paste customer data into a public chatbot and must use Lumora’s enterprise AI assistant instead [1][2]. Restricted data may only be accessed by authorized personnel, must be encrypted, and cannot be placed in public AI tools [4]. Personal data, including customer data, is also prohibited from being entered into public AI tools per the Data Privacy & Protection Policy [3].

question: How does the company 401(k) match work?
gold_answer: 100% of the first 4% contributed plus 50% of the next 2% (max 5%), with immediate vesting.
answer:
Lumora matches 100% of the first 4% of your salary that you contribute to the 401(k) and 50% of the next 2% you contribute, so the maximum match is 5% of salary once you contribute 6% or more [1][3].  
If you contribute 3% (the auto-enrollment default), the company adds a 3% match; at 4% contribution you receive a 4% match; at 5% contribution the match is 4.5%; and at 6% or higher you get the full 5% match [1][3].  
The matching contribution is calculated and deposited each pay period and includes both base salary and any annual bonus as eligible pay [1].  
All matching contributions vest immediately, meaning you own 100% of the match from the day it is made [2][3].
